note: What still needs the owner's Mac to run (Issue 56cf99cc). The growth guard counts needsMac as 'Mac dependencies'; the baseline in growth-baseline.json only falls. Remove an entry (and move it to offMac with how) when it runs elsewhere. Each entry needs an Issue that removes it or a staysBecause reason. No private paths or machine names: this repo is public.

needsMac.what: The lead agent session: planning, briefs, review, landing watch and the phone pings it sends.
needsMac.why: It runs in an interactive agent client signed in with the owner's own agent accounts, on the owner's Mac; nothing else can start or answer it.

needsMac.what: Up to about a dozen builder agent sessions with their Lane folders, dependency installs, heavy-test slots, the shared CLI cache and the CLI auto-update.
needsMac.why: They are child processes of the lead's agent client and use its sign-ins; Lane folders and caches (about 5 GiB a week, ec90cba2 bounds them) use this machine's disk and CPU.

needsMac.what: The exit bench harness and its agent arm (scripts/bench-*).
needsMac.why: It drives agents inside a macOS sandbox profile and samples this machine's load; its measurement hold also stops landings on the shared dev deployment (2e1f5fbd).

needsMac.what: Owner-only maintenance: global write pause, R2 maintenance and purge scripts, legacy storage cleanup and backfills, Convex env changes, durability drills.
needsMac.why: The lead runs them with a private deployment env file kept on this machine; there is no approved hosted path for them yet.

needsMac.what: The Mac check runner (`nforge worker`) that large-fixture and bench projects select as their check provider.
needsMac.staysBecause: An optional bring-your-own-machine runner stays as a product feature (0eead5d7 speeds it up). Dogfood checks run on GitHub-hosted runners, so only projects that opt in depend on it; it falls off this list when no Forge or dogfood path selects it.

offMac.how: Hosted main updated by compare-and-swap is the only accept path since the 2026-10-28 cutover.
Landing checks run on free GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners (forge-check workflow); the Mac check worker was stopped on 2026-10-29.
The hosted GitHub mirror pushes accepted main from the server; no local push.
Convex and web deploys to dev run from GitHub Actions on every deploy-relevant push to main.
The release-sign workflow signs CLI releases on a GitHub-hosted runner; the key exists only in its protected environment.
The hosted-backup workflow runs on a Monday 03:00 UTC schedule with environment-scoped secrets.
